text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "As the Hakodate Sprint Stakes approached, the reporter who had spoken to us after the Aoi Stakes reached out for an interview once again."

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your time!
Actually, ever since that Aoi Stakes,
I've been completely captivated by the world of speed—

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
We're planning to run a special feature
on the sprint division!
We'd love to hear what you have to say.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: A special feature...! That's incredible.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"If there's anything I can do to help...
I'll do my best to answer your questions.
...I look forward to working with you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the interview proceeded smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
“—I see!
So the training for the Summer Sprint is progressing very smoothly...!”

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
"No, thank you so much!
I feel like I'll be able to write an article that really builds hype for the current sprint division...!"
choice_data_list: How hyped things are right now, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, compared to massive headline news like
'Tokai Teio Wins the Derby!',
I suppose it does pale in comparison, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text: Even so, the more seasoned race fans are saying, 'Short distances are actually super exciting right now!'

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
The biggest news is definitely Daiichi Ruby from
the "Splendid Clan" switching to sprints!
She even clinched a graded stakes win right at the start of the yearâ

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
Because in the race after that,
she went head-to-head with Bamboo Memory
and pulled off a magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
As a new heroine showing off such breathtaking bursts of speed,
she's completely stolen the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Bamboo Memory's popularity as the reigning
sprint champion shows no sign of waning—

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, making a huge name for herself right now is Daitaku Helios!

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
Helios-san was also running in the race
where Bamboo-san and Ruby-san clashed...
and unbelievably, she came in second place!

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text: It's like... whenever Daiichi Ruby's around, her running completely changes. You'd never guess she could be so fiercely strong!

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, sorry for rambling on for so long.
A-Anyway, what I mean is!
The sprint division is super exciting right now!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see... Ruby, and everyone else too.
You're all growing stronger and stronger, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
And with that!
Thank you very much for today!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
............

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I thought today's plan was just to head straight back to the dorms after finishing the interview, though...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Just for a bit.
Can I do some solo training before heading home?
choice_data_list: ...Does this have something to do with what we heard earlier?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
As long as I keep running short distances like this,
I don't think facing off against everyone can be avoided.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I just want to build up my strength... even a little,
to be ready for when that time comes."
choice_data_list: Okay. But I'm coming with you.
Okay. But I'm coming with you, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, I wouldn't want to trouble you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: U-Uuun...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is this really okay...? I feel like
everyone's just constantly spoiling me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me.
Well then, I'd appreciate your help for just a bit."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after training session upon session
together with K.S. Miracle—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the competing Umamusume
are appearing in the paddock one after another!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Summer Sprint,
the Hakodate Sprint Stakes—
is finally underway!
